note: Voice lines for the dialogue, rendered by tools/render-voices.mjs (run by the Render voices workflow). Words follow the hand lettering; bracketed directions are audio tags and are not spoken. A line renders only when its voice is set; changing a line's text, voice or settings renders it again. The Render voices workflow runs whenever this file changes on main or the working branch. Spoken text may differ from the lettering for pronunciation: "Canes" is said "caynis" (Paul), so it is spelt "Caynis"; the hyphens make "Spomenik-Operative-Bob" one name, QNTM CTRL is said "quantum control", and Cryptoflage rhymes with camouflage, so it is spelt "Crypto-flahzh". "Engage..." is a stern monotone command (Paul, 24 October): high stability, and a full stop rather than an exclamation mark. All lines use Eleven v4 (eleven_v4, Paul, 24 October), which takes only stability and similarity_boost as settings (style and speaker boost are not supported), so pacing and delivery come from the audio tags and punctuation. A line's "take" number asks for a fresh render of the same words: raise it to hear another take.
